verdict.rationale: RevenueCat ships native subscription charts built from the purchase data it stores, not an external BI layer (revenuecat-docs-6, revenuecat-docs-23). The evidence explicitly covers lifetime value charting (revenuecat-gh-4) and MRR analysis through Rico (revenuecat-docs-10), plus segmentation by acquisition source (revenuecat-docs-22). missing for 10: explicit evidence of churn and cohort retention metrics, in-depth documentation of metric definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration of analytics accuracy.
